senses.sense_definition: A person, thing, or concept that is the direct or exact opposite of another.

examples.text: His total lack of empathy is the exact <w>antithesis</w> of his brother's kindness. balconies. His behavior was the <w>direct antithesis</w> of everything the company stood for.
His rude behavior was the <w>direct antithesis</w> of the polite reputation he claimed to have.

senses.sense_definition: A figure of speech in which contrasting ideas are juxtaposed in balanced phrases or sentences.

examples.text: The speechwriter made effective use of <w>antithesis</w> to highlight the contrast between war and peace.
In rhetoric, using an <w>antithesis</w> can make an argument far more memorable to the audience.

senses.sense_definition: The second stage of a dialectical process, which negates or opposes the original thesis.

examples.text: In Hegelian philosophy, the thesis and the <w>antithesis</w> are resolved into a synthesis.
The scholar explained how the historical movement acted as an <w>antithesis</w> to previous social ideas.
